reason: The harvest needs a basket lined with soft fabric, so the cargo mesh and clean cover fabric are natural parts to combine.
expectation: The mesh and fabric will make a soft-lined harvest basket.

effect: The lined basket is ready, and the new goal is to taste the harvest.
reaction: The soft lining makes practical sense for protecting the leaves.
reason: The lettuce tray and basket are the obvious next pairing for harvesting the leaves.
expectation: I can gather lettuce in the lined basket for preparation.

effect: The lettuce is harvested; the leaves can now be prepared at the sink.
reaction: Leaving the centre growing is a satisfying practical detail.
reason: The clean preparation sink is the natural place to wash the fresh leaves before tasting them.
expectation: The leaves will be washed and ready to eat.

effect: Washing the harvested leaves and adding them to a stored meal completed the chapter's final goal.
reaction: The contrast between the fresh green meal and the barren landscape was a satisfying ending.

mostWorthwhile.text: Harvesting the outer leaves while leaving the centre growing was a practical detail that made the growing room feel useful beyond a single meal.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the lined basket was sensible but predictable; it offered little uncertainty as a decision.

surprise.text: Leaving the lettuce centre growing was a nice detail I had not anticipated when choosing to harvest it.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary: the basket protected the leaves, and the sink prepared them for the meal.

continue.text: Yes. The practical details and the payoff of a fresh meal make me curious how the expedition develops next, though this chapter's combinations were straightforward.
